entities.name: Ibn al-Mundhir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir al-Naysaburi was a student of Shafi'i scholar al-Rabi' ibn Sulayman who was in turn a direct student of al-Shafi'i. He would later reach the level of ijtihad but with little exception ascribe to the legal opinions of al-Shafi'i.
